scope: Legacy uploaded JAR + pinned source with 1.20.1 adaptation evidence; no runtime tests

cards.title: Encode terrain work as path-node actions
cards.invariant: A route may contain both movement and world-edit operations; movement cannot advance past an unfinished action.
cards.limits: Do not copy legacy static synchronized PathfinderIM.

cards.title: Select infrastructure with counterfactual re-pathing
cards.invariant: Evaluate candidate construction by re-running the route with a hypothetical overlay instead of mutating the live world.
cards.limits: Path snapshots/overlays must remain isolated from live world mutation.

cards.title: Overlay crowd density into path cost
cards.invariant: Tactical occupancy data is a separate pathing layer, not physical terrain.
cards.limits: Update budget must be bounded for large waves.

cards.title: Execute terrain changes as costed transactions
cards.invariant: Planned world edits are owned, reach-bounded, timed and acknowledge success/failure.

cards.title: Compose waves from overlapping time and direction windows
cards.invariant: Spawn rhythm, unit mix and attack direction are separate parameters with terrain-aware fallback.
cards.limits: Blocked spawn obligations require explicit completion policy.

cards.title: Separate path desirability from demolition resistance
cards.invariant: Movement preference and break time are different tactical properties.
cards.limits: Avoid double-counting vanilla malus, custom cost and work cost.

cards.title: Give specialists small cooperation contracts
cards.invariant: Followers can wait/assist a route-builder and suppress conflicting work without a global squad brain.
cards.limits: Modern goal arbitration needs explicit ownership/exclusion.

cards.title: Amortize expensive spatial discovery
cards.invariant: Large scans produce a committed result over bounded per-tick work rather than one tick spike.
cards.limits: Consumers need a defined behavior while generation is incomplete.

cards.title: Keep failure accounting separate from kill accounting
cards.invariant: An impossible spawn can discharge a scheduler obligation without being recorded as a combat kill.
cards.limits: Player-facing progress must explain skipped obligations.
